title: My Interview at AccTechCo: Part One
excerpt: My interview at AccTechCo for a Data Analyst position was the best vibe I've had so far. Calm, honest, and surprisingly a technical interview.

blocks.text: AccTechCo Company - Part One (Maybe There Will Be a Part Two)

I was invited to interview for a Data Analyst position at this company. When I entered, they gave me a form to fill in. Honestly, these forms don't give me a good feeling because all the information needed is already in my resume and I really have nothing new to say to write in those forms.
Anyway, when I filled the form I sat in the waiting room and after 4-5 minutes they called me.
The initial encounter was good and their HR person had come down to get me. We went up together by elevator to the third floor (I don't remember exactly).

The first thing that caught my attention was that it was really big 😅 It didn't match the appearance of that building at all that it would be that big, but it was really complicated and maze-like, and the first sentence I said was: well, I'm going to get lost here from now on :)
I had no stress for the interview, I don't know why... but in general I go to interviews very relaxed... like I know there's really nothing to worry about.
The Interview
The interview was with that same HR lady and the head of the Data Analysis team. First they asked me to introduce myself and explain about myself, and I talked about myself for about 3-4 minutes.

The first question was about my previous company, Snapp Carfix. They asked why I left and exactly from what time to what time I worked there. I explained the reasons to them. I was also honest. Honesty was very important.

Based on the explanations I gave, they were also hiring for the Automation team and they told me, given the expertise you have, which side are you interested in? And based on the explanations they gave, and my own personal interest, I chose the same data analysis team.

No strange and weird questions were asked either, mostly about the projects I had worked on, the things I knew that could help this organization make better data-driven decisions, and I answered honestly that I had worked from understanding and EDA and the basic work with data, to machine learning-based solutions, and to solutions based on language models and Agents, and in general I'm a good Problem Solver.
Because the interview vibe was very very good and really positive and, as I like to say, a "happy game", no strange or challenging topics came up at all.
And the interesting point was that I realized this interview was a technical interview!
And I was honestly very happy too.
Final Questions
In the end I also asked them two or three questions about the company and the work they do, the average length of time people stay here, and...

A very great interview, it went calmly and with a good vibe. There was no strange or weird expectation and they really understood whether someone actually knows something or not. I think the interview length was at most 30 minutes or 45 minutes.

And in the end I found out that if this stage is approved, the second interview stage will be with the HR team, and after that it will be determined how much the offered salary is and whether I will be accepted or not.
So if you see this company doesn't have a note number 2, it means I wasn't accepted and wasn't invited to the second round 😁
So Is AccTechCo Worth It?
Yes yes yes - out of all the companies I had interviewed at so far, I had a better vibe and feeling and it really seemed more valuable than SnappCarfix - Anacav - Iranicard - Irisa Prime and...
This observation and opinion of mine is also just based on my interview experience, I don't have much news from inside the company for now.
I personally liked them and I hope I get invited for the second interview. If I don't, then I don't, the world hasn't come to an end.
